AC: TC-NGUI-3776-001 - PML accepts the maximum value 999,999% (Specialty - Energy / Construction)
Steps:
1. Open a Specialty - Energy (Construction) program on the Financial Layers tab in edit mode.
2. In the layer's PML field enter 999999.
3. Tab out of the field.
4. Click Save.
5. Reload the page and open the Financial Layers tab.
Expected results: No validation error is shown on the PML field. "Financial layers saved" is displayed. After reload PML shows 999,999% (not truncated or rounded).

AC: TC-NGUI-3776-002 - PML rejects a value just above the maximum
Steps:
1. Open a Specialty - Energy (Construction) program on the Financial Layers tab in edit mode.
2. In the PML field enter 1000000 (and, if decimals are allowed, 999999.01).
3. Tab out of the field.
4. Try to click Save.
Expected results: The PML field is marked invalid with a validation message stating the maximum (999,999%). The layer is not saved and the previously saved PML value is unchanged after reload.

AC: TC-NGUI-3776-016 - Existing program: PML value is updated to the new maximum
Steps:
1. Open an existing Specialty - Energy program with a saved layer where PML = 100.
2. Go to the Financial Layers tab and click Edit.
3. Change PML from 100 to 999999.
4. Click Save.
5. Reload the page.
Expected results: Save succeeds with no validation error. After reload PML = 999,999% and no other layer fields have changed.
